# `ref-extracted`

Inline schema became a $ref

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `sdk` |
| **Default severity** | `info` · `--profile sdk`: `warn` |
| **Rule IDs** | `ref-extracted` |
| **Status** | Planned (M5) |
| **Group** | References and components ([RULES.md section 8](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An inline schema was moved into a component and replaced by a `$ref`.

## Why this default

Generated SDKs get a new named type in place of an anonymous one; code may need updating. The wire format is unchanged.

## Example

_No example yet: one is added with the rule's test case when the rule is implemented._

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  ref-extracted: info
```

## How to fix

Usually nothing; check the SDK change is intended.
